# 0. Set-up
```{r set-up}
#----------------------------------------------------------#
# Predicting outcomes after AKI using multistate models
# Code for final analyses
# Roemer J. Janse - Last updated on 2026-02-19
#----------------------------------------------------------#

# Load packages
pacman::p_load("dplyr",          # Data wrangling
               "magrittr",       # Efficient pipelines
               "tidyr",          # Data pivoting
               "stringr",        # Working with strings
               "purrr",          # Functional programming
               "here",           # Local paths
               "tableone",       # Baseline characteristics table
               "ggplot2",        # Data visualisation
               "calibmsm",       # Calibration for multistate models
               "patchwork",      # Patching plots together
               "knitr",          # Printing to word
               "conflicted"      # Resolve function conflicts
)

# Resolve function conflicts
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter) # Between stats and dplyr

# Load functions
walk(list.files(here("funs")), \(x) source(paste0(here("funs"), "/", x)))

# Set path
path <- psp(unix = "/volumes/Data/lab/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/",
            windows = "L:/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/")

# Set path for figures
path_fig <- psp(unix = "/Users/rjanse5/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UMCUtrecht/Documenten/Projects/202508 - Multistate AKI - Denise/figures/",
                windows = "L:/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/")

# Load cohort data
loadr("outcome_derivation_em.Rdata")

# Load covars
loadr("vec_covars.Rdata")

# Set parameters for performance
timepoints <- c(1:9 * 365.25, 3652)

```

# 1. Baseline characteristics ----
```{r baseline characteristics}
# List of variables for table 1
vec_var <- c(# Demographics
             "age", "female", "lab_bmi", "bmi_missing",
             # Index AKI
             "pre_aki_egfr", "stage", "egfr",
             # Hospitalisation characteristics
             "los", "ihe_cts", "ihe_ncts", "ihe_resc",
             # Comorbidities
             "com_arr", "com_aid", "com_cad", "com_cbvd", "com_copd", "com_diab", "com_hf", "com_hltx", "com_hyp", "com_liver", 
             "com_mal", "com_pad", "com_pckd",
             # Medication
             "med_aht", "med_ata", "med_gla", "med_ims", "med_lla", "med_ntd",
             # Laboratory values
             "lab_hb", "hb_missing", "lab_k", "k_missing", "lab_n", "n_missing", "lab_urea", "urea_missing", "lab_crp", "crp_missing",
```

# 2. Endpoint model
```{r em set-up}
# Load predictions
loadr("predictions_fixed_em.Rdata")

# Load multistate data
loadr("dat_mstate_em.Rdata")

# Load multistate fit object
loadr("mstate_fit_em.Rdata")

# Set outcomes
outcomes <- c("kf", "macce", "macce_kf", "death")

```

## 2.1. Print model coefficients
```{r}
# Get coefficients
tab_coef_em <- extract_coefs(fit)

# Get baseline hazards at timepoints of interest
tab_bhaz_em <- extract_bhaz(fit, timepoints)

```

## 2.2. Model performance
### 2.2.1. PDI at every year
```{r pdi em}
# Prepare data for PDI calculation
dat_pdi <- pdi_prep(dat_prds_fixed, timepoints, dat_spine_em, outcomes)

# Calculate PDI for each timepoint
dat_pdis_em <- bind_rows(lapply(timepoints, \(x) pdi(dat_pdi, outcomes, x)))

# Change format for table
tab_pdis_em <- dat_pdis_em %>%
  # Create result column
  mutate(
    # Round PDI and rescaled PDI
    across(pdi:pdi_resc, \(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2)),
    # Create variable that contains both
    pdi = paste0(pdi, " (", pdi_resc, ")")
  ) %>%
  # Drop PDI rescaled
  select(-pdi_resc) %>%
  # Set to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "time",
    values_from = "pdi"
  )

# Create plot for PDIs
plt_pdis_em <- plot_pdi(dat_pdis_em, outcomes)

# Save plot
ggsaver(plt_pdis_em, "pdis_em", 8, 11)

```

```{r calibration em}
# Prepare data for calibration
lst_cal <- cal_prep(dat_spine_em, dat_prds_fixed, timepoints, outcomes)

# Get calibration data at each timepoint
dat_cal <- lapply(timepoints, \(x){
  # Run calibration
  dat_cal_timepoint <- cal(
    dat_mstate = dat_mstate,
    dat_raw = lst_cal[["dat_raw"]],
    dat_prd = lst_cal[["dat_prd"]],
    timepoint = x,
    method = "mlr",
    smoother = "loess",
    w_covs = vec_covars
  )
  
  # Return output
  return(x = dat_cal_timepoint)
})

# Get calibration plots 
plt_cal_em <- lapply(1:length(timepoints), \(x){
  # Get calibration plot
  p <- plot_cal(dat_cal[[x]][["dat_plot"]],
           outcomes
  )
  
  # Return plot
  return(x = p)
})

# Save calibration plots
walk(1:length(plt_cal_em), \(x) ggsaver(plt_cal_em[[x]], paste0("plt_cal_em_y", x), 6, 6))

# Extract data for CITL
dat_citl_em <- bind_rows(lapply(1:length(timepoints), \(x) extract_citl(dat_cal, x, outcomes)))

# Table for CITL
tab_citl_em <- dat_citl_em %>%
  # Set to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "time",
    values_from = "citl"
  )

```
